messages:
Alice M: heads up — customer ticket #C-917 has a latency complaint: p95 for /v1/generate in us-west-2 jumped from ~370ms to ~710ms over the last 15m, p99 hitting ~1.2s. error-rate OK (0.2%), but long tail bad. can oncall triage?
oncall-bot: ALERT: latency_p99_high service=/v1/generate region=us-west-2 p99=1.18s p95=710ms spike_start=2024-04-20T16:12:10Z
Carol (SRE): thanks — I'm checking request size distribution and batch sizes. any recent deploys?
Bob C: no deploys to inference runtime in last 6 hours. we did push a model weights update to redwood-large at 15:30, but no serve-config change. link: https://git.redwood/changes/PR-4821
David - EngOncall: ok quick mitigation options: 1) enable fallback routing to redwood-medium for low-priority keys, 2) enable circuit-breaker for slow requests at gateway (5xx/latency) threshold, 3) temporarily reduce max_batch_size to 8 on the pool in us-west-2, 4) apply token-level throttling for the noisy client in ticket. which to try first?
Alice M: fallback model first, tell me how to flip it from console or CLI so we can message the customer ASAP.
Carol (SRE): grabbing percentile traces. sample log from node-7: 
```
[2024-04-20T16:18:02Z] req=abcd1234 model=redwood-large seq_len=1024 batch=16 latency_ms=1190 kernel_wait_ms=830 kv-miss=true
[2024-04-20T16:18:03Z] req=efgh5678 model=redwood-large seq_len=128 batch=12 latency_ms=1150 kernel_wait_ms=760 kv-miss=false
```
Carol (SRE): looks like KV cache misses + bigger batches causing kernel stalls. fallback to medium (smaller memory) reduces kernel time. also batch pressure visible.
David - EngOncall: commands to activate immediate fallback via rcli and to flip circuit-breaker: 
```
# route low-priority keys to redwood-medium in us-west-2
rcli routing update --region us-west-2 --selector "tier:free OR customer:C-917" --fallback-model redwood-medium --priority 10

# enable latency circuit breaker (trip at p99>900ms for 5m)
rcli ops circuit-breaker set --service /v1/generate --region us-west-2 --metric p99_latency_ms --threshold 900 --window 300 --action return_503

# reduce max batch size for pool gw-usw2-1
rcli pool update gw-usw2-1 --max-batch 8
```
Bob C: I'm going to open an internal support note and inform the CS rep about the fallback. will include roll-forward steps and impact.
Alice M: do we need to notify customers about 503s if circuit-breaker trips? prefer fallback model + batch reduction first to avoid 503.
David - EngOncall: agreed. I'll apply the routing update now and monitor. if p99 doesn't drop within 3m, we'll enable batch cap next. if still bad, toggle circuit-breaker to protect downstream.
David - EngOncall: (applied) routing update succeeded: fallback policy active for selector "customer:C-917" -> redwood-medium in us-west-2.
Carol (SRE): telemetry update 2m after change: p95 ~420ms, p99 ~680ms. kernel wait improved. KV cache warmup in progress.
Alice M: thanks. I'll tell the CS rep we applied fallback model and are watching for 30m; also offered temporary rate-limit for that noisy key if they want it.
Bob C: support note created: SN-2024-217 — records steps and rollback plan (revert rcli routing update, set max-batch back to 32).
Carol (SRE): follow-up checklist for post-incident: 1) investigate root cause of KV miss spike (was model weights rollout affecting cache keys?), 2) add automatic suggestion to Optimize for batch tuning when p99/kv-miss correlation > 0.5, 3) consider softer circuit-breaker config that returns cached fallback responses rather than 503s.
Alice M: assigning follow-ups to Carol and David. I'll update the ticket and close thread once metrics stable for 30m. :thumbsup:
David - EngOncall: noted — will add a short mitigations playbook snippet to the ops repo: "fallback-first, batch-cap second, CB last" and include exact rcli commands.
Carol (SRE): metrics stable at 30m: p95=410ms p99=650ms. closing loop in 10m then will revert fallback if no regression.
Alice M: appreciated.
Bob C: marking SN-2024-217 as waiting-customer.
David - EngOncall: final: revert plan ready. revert command: `rcli routing update --region us-west-2 --selector "customer:C-917" --fallback-model "" --priority 0`
Alice M: thread resolved for now — will reopen if customer sees any degradation. :white_check_mark:
